Climber.description: A gym member or staff climber. A first name alone is not an identity.

Route.description: A set route or boulder problem on the walls, whoever set or climbed it.

Setting.description:
Who did what for a route: the setter who built it, the tester who foreruns it before opening.
Testing a route is not setting it.

Partnership.description: Who a climber depends on: a belayer who holds their rope, or an instructor who teaches them.

Incident.description: An accident or near miss on the walls. faller is who fell, reported_by logged it, first_aider treated the faller.

questions.q: Who is the setter of Slab of Doubt?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Route)-[:setter]->(n1:Climber) WHERE n0.label = 'Slab of Doubt' RETURN n1.member_name AS member_name

questions.q: Who was the tester for Orange Crimp Line?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Route)-[:tester]->(n1:Climber) WHERE n0.label = 'Orange Crimp Line' RETURN n1.member_name AS member_name

questions.speaker: zainab
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Climber)-[:set]->(n1:Route) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.label AS label

questions.q: Which routes has Kalani Akana tested?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Climber)-[:tested]->(n1:Route) WHERE n0.member_name = 'Kalani Akana' RETURN n1.label AS label

questions.speaker: esperanza
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Climber)-[:belayer]->(n1:Climber) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.member_name AS member_name
MATCH (n0:Climber)-[:instructor]->(n1:Climber) WHERE n0.member_name = 'Ngaio Harker' RETURN n1.member_name AS member_name
MATCH (n0:Climber)-[:student]->(n1:Climber) WHERE n0.member_name = 'Arjun Mehrotra' RETURN n1.member_name AS member_name

questions.q: Is there a record of an ambulance for the Slab of Doubt incident?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Route)<-[:route]-(n1:Incident) WHERE n0.label = 'Slab of Doubt' RETURN coalesce(n1.ambulance_called, false) AS ambulance_called

questions.q: Was an ambulance called for the Blue Dyno Arete incident?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Route)<-[:route]-(n1:Incident) WHERE n0.label = 'Blue Dyno Arete' RETURN n1.ambulance_called AS ambulance_called

questions.q: How many metres were the falls in incidents reported by Liesel Brandauer?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Climber)<-[:reported_by]-(n1:Incident) WHERE n0.member_name = 'Liesel Brandauer' RETURN n1.fall_metres AS fall_metres

questions.q: Who gave first aid when I fell?
questions.speaker: esperanza
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Climber)<-[:faller]-(n1:Incident)-[:first_aider]->(n2:Climber) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n2.member_name AS member_name

questions.q: Which route was the incident with the loose hanger on?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Incident)-[:route]->(n1:Route) WHERE n0.details CONTAINS 'hanger' RETURN n1.label AS label

questions.q: List every incident with its severity and fall height.
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Incident) RETURN n0.severity AS severity, n0.fall_metres AS fall_metres

questions.q: What is Arjun Mehrotra's membership number?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Climber) WHERE n0.member_name = 'Arjun Mehrotra' RETURN n0.membership_no AS membership_no

questions.q: Who fell on Cave Roof Traverse?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Route)<-[:route]-(n1:Incident)-[:faller]->(n2:Climber) WHERE n0.label = 'Cave Roof Traverse' RETURN n2.member_name AS member_name
